scenes.title: Where and when
narration: Luoshan Dragon is a traditional dragon dance of the Lishui District and Fengzhen Luoshan Village, Nanjing, China, boasting a history spanning over 400 years and recognized as local intangible cultural heritage.

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: A significant local folk cultural activity taking place from the 24th day of the twelfth lunar month to the 18th day of the first lunar month, engaging over 500 performers representing every household.
Today it is a living tradition.

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: The performance spans twenty-five days across three stages: drafting, the consecration of the White Dragon, and the dragon dance, which features segments like Playing with the Pearl, Dragon Leaping, and Cloud Leaping.
Watch for Playing with the Pearl, Dragon Leaping, Cloud Leaping.
on_screen: Captions name each signature move as it appears
Formation: Performers line up in order before the Dragon Association gate and divide into alternating teams on the shores of Shijiu Lake.
